verdict.reasons: The white-and-blue cylindrical AFP drip-tape carton roll is clearly visible, authentic, and integrated naturally into the agricultural field. Installed laterals are present alongside the seedlings, satisfying the technical evidence requirements without the packaging being used as physical hardware.

focused_physical_review.reason: The irrigation line on the right maintains a visible distance from the carton base, with no physical contact or crossing. However, the soil gap is not clear around the complete footprint of the package; the line runs close to the immediate right of the cylinder, and soil texture/irrigation proximity prevents a 'broad uninterrupted gap' classification. There are no additional loose coils, and no white ribbons or strip tails are protruding from the package sides or base.

acceptance_warnings: Independent physical condition not met: clear_soil_gap

acceptance_decision.source: user requested practical >=90 acceptance; actual saved vision evidence retained
